paragraphs.text: Hench was a small town in Yotia during the Brothers' War on Dominaria .

Hench was a small trade post on the road leading from Yotia towards Korlis , not very far east from the capital city of Kroog . During the Fall of Kroog , Hench was used as a meeting place beyond the city, where refugees and wounded gathered to find each other. Sanwell and Rica traveled to Hench after the death of the rest of their Avenger squad.

It is not known what happened to Hench later during the war, but it was likely sacked in the plunder of Yotia. Eventually, the land where Hench was located would be inundated in the Flooding of Terisiare , and submerged beneath the Sea of Laments .
